mapper.sql: SELECT p.id AS patientId, p.study_no AS studyNo, p.name, p.gender, p.age, YEAR(COALESCE(p.create_date, p.createDate)) AS createYear, p.follow_cycle AS followCycle, IFNULL(v.visitCount, 0) AS visitCount, v.lastVisit, v.firstVisit, CASE WHEN w.patient_id IS NULL AND v.lastVisit IS NOT NULL THEN DATE_ADD(DATE(v.lastVisit), INTERVAL p.follow_cycle MONTH) END AS nextDue, CASE WHEN w.patient_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'withdrawn' WHEN IFNULL(v.visitCount, 0) = 0 THEN 'pending_first' WHEN DATE_ADD(DATE(v.lastVisit), INTERVAL p.follow_cycle MONTH) < CURDATE() THEN 'overdue' WHEN DATE_ADD(DATE(v.lastVisit), INTERVAL p.follow_cycle MONTH) <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 14 DAY) THEN 'soon' ELSE 'active' END AS followStatus, q.missingCodes FROM patient_basic_info p JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM patient_relation_doctor WHERE doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND research_type IN ()) d ON d.patient_id = p.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM patient_relation_doctor WHERE miss = 1 AND research_type IN ()) w ON w.patient_id = p.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT f.patient_basic_info_id AS pid, COUNT(*) AS visitCount, MAX(COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate)) AS lastVisit, MIN(COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate)) AS firstVisit FROM patient_follow_up_history f WHERE f.research_type IN () AND f.patient_basic_info_id IN (SELECT r.patient_id FROM patient_relation_doctor r WHERE r.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND r.research_type IN ()) GROUP BY f.patient_basic_info_id) v ON v.pid = p.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.patient_id, GROUP_CONCAT(t.rule_code ORDER BY t.rule_code) AS missingCodes FROM () t WHERE t.rule_code LIKE 'M\_%' GROUP BY t.patient_id) q ON q.patient_id = p.id WHERE p.id = #{patientId}

where.if: AND (x.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CAST(x.patientId AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR x.studyNo LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalPatients, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN x.missingCodes IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS incompleteCount FROM () x

SELECT x.patientId, x.studyNo, x.name, x.gender, x.age, x.createYear, x.followCycle, x.visitCount, DATE_FORMAT(x.firstVisit, '%Y-%m-%d') AS firstVisitDate, DATE_FORMAT(x.lastVisit, '%Y-%m-%d') AS lastVisitDate, DATE_FORMAT(x.nextDue, '%Y-%m-%d') AS nextDueDate, x.followStatus, x.missingCodes FROM () x
ORDER BY x.lastVisit IS NULL, x.lastVisit DESC, x.patientId DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT f.patient_basic_info_id AS patientId, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(f.bqpg, '$.result.crpScore')) AS das28 FROM patient_follow_up_history f WHERE f.patient_basic_info_id IN #{id} AND f.research_type IN () AND f.bqpg LIKE '%"crpScore":%' AND JSON_VALID(f.bqpg) ORDER BY f.patient_basic_info_id, COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate) IS NULL, COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate) DESC, f.id DESC
SELECT patient_id AS patientId, disease_code AS code, since_year AS sinceYear FROM patient_comorbidity WHERE patient_id IN #{id} ORDER BY patient_id, id

SELECT p.id AS patientId, p.mobile, p.card_no AS cardNo, p.nation, p.marry, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(p.create_date, p.createDate), '%Y-%m-%d') AS createDate, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(p.confirm_date, p.confirmDate), '%Y-%m-%d') AS confirmDate, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(p.happen_date, p.happenDate), '%Y-%m-%d') AS happenDate, p.height, p.weight, p.smoke, COALESCE(p.smoke_years, p.smokeYears) AS smokeYears, COALESCE(p.smoke_count_by_day, p.smokeCountByDay) AS smokeCountByDay, COALESCE(p.smoke_stop, p.smokeStop) AS smokeStop, p.allergy, p.gms, p.jzs, p.jws, (SELECT CONCAT_WS('；', NULLIF(TRIM(r.reason), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(r.other_miss_reason), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(r.note), '')) FROM patient_relation_doctor r WHERE r.patient_id = p.id AND r.miss = 1 AND r.research_type IN () ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS withdrawReason FROM patient_basic_info p WHERE p.id = #{patientId} AND p.id IN (SELECT r.patient_id FROM patient_relation_doctor r WHERE r.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND r.research_type IN ())

SELECT f.id AS visitId, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate), '%Y-%m-%d') AS visitDate, f.doctor_id AS doctorId, u.name AS doctorName FROM patient_follow_up_history f LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = f.doctor_id WHERE f.patient_basic_info_id = #{patientId} AND f.research_type IN () ORDER BY COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate) IS NULL, COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate) DESC, f.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patient_relation_doctor WHERE doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND patient_id = #{patientId} AND research_type IN ()
SELECT card_no FROM patient_basic_info WHERE id = #{patientId}
